body:
Hi team — could you share the planned release timeline for the custom archiver server option introduced in #9090?

### Context

- PR #9090 ("Add server option for customizing archiver implementation") was merged into `main` on 2026-03-24.
- The change appears in internal/pre-release tags such as [`v1.31.0-154.2`](https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/releases/tag/v1.31.0-154.2), but it is not yet included in any published official release.
- The latest official release is `v1.30.4` (2026-04-10), which predates the change on the release branch.

### Ask

1. Which upcoming minor release is this feature targeted for (e.g. `v1.31.0`)?
2. Is there an approximate ETA for that release?
3. Is there a recommended, supported way to consume the feature in the meantime (e.g. pinning to one of the `v1.31.0-*` pre-release tags), or is that not advised for production?

Thanks!

comments.body: Next minor release v1.31 is planned to be published next week.

title: Release timeline for custom archiver server option (PR #9090)
